title: The Echo of the Last
overview: In 2034, humanity became mired in screen dependence, and technology began to replace reality. Maxim — a man who has lost touch with himself and the world around him — finds himself drawn into an apocalyptic series of events. The mysterious Black Circle appears in the city, destroying the usual order and paralyzing people. Maxim desperately tries to save his son, who is attracted by the mysterious power of the Circle.
